speed: n/a — the frame does not move for twelve seconds; the change is read off the set
start_frame: The locked wide of the hall with the whole glass table, the west door line and the lamp row all inside the frame: Alice at the table edge at 1.35 m, setting the empty bottle down, the tabletop at her waist and the doors a little taller than she is.
end_frame: The same frame, not a millimetre moved: the glass table has risen past her into a tower, the oak doors have soared into cliffs under their iron arches and the lamps swing far overhead — she is ten inches high on the spot where she stood, her feet never having moved.
constraint_honoured: 'MUST NOT BE CUT INSIDE. The frame DOES NOT MOVE for twelve seconds: the change is read off the set, never off the lens' — no move, no morph, no glow; the permitted hidden-cut substitution to the oversized build happens inside a frame that is optically identical before and after.
movement_note: The episode's longest take. Any camera movement at all would give the audience an optical event to blame the size change on, which is the one thing CR-005 forbids.
